proposed_widenings.name: perform_action
proposed_widenings.justification: The primary mechanic is 'You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action.' The activation cost is the Bonus Action; the result of spending it is that the Dash action is performed. No EffectAtom represents 'perform a named standard action.' grant_extra_action is semantically wrong — it grants an additional full action, whereas here the Bonus Action itself is repurposed as the Dash. A new atom such as { kind: 'perform_action'; action: StandardActionKind } (or a 'grant_action_as_bonus_action' activation-cost variant) is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action.

proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount.proficiency_bonus
proposed_widenings.justification: The Temporary Hit Point grant is 'a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.' DiceAmount has no variant expressing this. DiceExpr supports spellcastingMod and abilityModifier but not PB. UseCountCap already has { kind: 'proficiency_bonus' } for resource caps; DiceAmount needs the same. Suggested: { kind: 'proficiency_bonus' } parallel to UseCountCap.proficiency_bonus.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus

notes: The resource model (use_count cap=proficiency_bonus, short_or_long_rest reset) and the grant_temp_hp atom both exist structurally. Only the amount encoding and the Dash-action effect are missing. The Dash component is the primary mechanic of the trait, so omitting it from a dhall encoding would produce a dishonest trace. No content files authored.
